issue_request: FHIR-18505 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 OperationOutcome correction asking the narrative near operationoutcome.html#loc to stop referring only to the location element and instead say applications can use the expression element to refer to a location inside a resource.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was already applied. Git history shows e8c22a3727 for FHIR-17589 first deprecated OperationOutcome.issue.location and reworked the page toward expression-based reporting; d3ea5f3436, labelled for adjacent FHIR-18508, then changed the relevant narrative from location element wording to expression element wording.
additional_context: FHIR-17589 is the underlying published decision to deprecate OperationOutcome.issue.location and rework the documentation. FHIR-18507, identified in FHIR-18505 comments as the main issue, was resolved no-change because location had already been deprecated. Current fhir.ini actively includes OperationOutcome, and current StructureDefinition source keeps issue.location only as deprecated and replaced by issue.expression.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active OperationOutcome narrative already says applications use the expression element consistently and can use it to refer to locations inside resources or HTTP requests, matching the FHIR-18505 resolution.
